jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Nordnet is redefining the landscape of savings and investments, guiding over 2.5 million customers in their financial lives. We have spent the last years building a modern data platform and fostering a culture where actionable insights and rapid product refinement are part of our DNA. In our fast-paced environment, this remains a competitive edge - allowing us to ship, learn, and iterate faster than the market.

Now we are seeking to engage a passionate Data Analyst to join our team.

###### **The role**

As a Data Analyst at Nordnet, you will be a part of Data & Insights, where you have the opportunity to work alongside Data analysts, Data Scientists, Analytics Engineers and Data Engineers.

You will be embedded in our Product development teams, where you will be an integral component, working with designers, product leads and developers. You will deep-dive into our users and our products, and turn data into actionable insights.

We would love it if you feel excited about at least some of these statements.

* Going beyond simple questions, defining a problem and understanding the right analytical approach
* Conduct statistical analyses on our customer -, financial -, and company data to identify patterns of behaviour
* Design experiments to evaluate various hypotheses and design choices
* Utilize AI and advanced modeling to scale your impact
* Craft and present compelling stories that will impact our decision makers
* Help improve our existing methodologies

###### **This is you**

You are passionate about data and learning new things, and you want to contribute with your experience and ideas. In your work, you are organised, methodical and agile in a way that benefits the team’s working climate and ability to deliver solutions.

To thrive in this role, we believe that most of these criteria describe you:

* Proactive, with a strong sense of ownership
* A strong communicator with the ability to engage both technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Experience of using SQL, Python, R and dbt
* Hands-on experience with A/B testing
* Degree in economics, data science, statistics, engineering, mathematics, or similar

We think that you have 3+ years experience working as a Data Analyst at a product oriented organisation.

**What we offer**

We are committed to your continuous growth, offering a space where you can learn, contribute, and take ownership of your technical domain over time. At Nordnet, we offer:

* A hybrid work model balancing remote flexibility with collaboration in our Stockholm office.
* 5,000 SEK annual wellness contribution (friskvårdsbidrag).
* A culture that values continuous learning and technical ownership.

Visit us on www.nordnetab.com,www.nordnet.se, www.nordnet.no, www.nordnet.dk and www.nordnet.fi.

###### **Application**

At Nordnet, we know that the best products are built by teams with a mix of different backgrounds and perspectives. If you are excited about the challenges we’re solving and see yourself contributing to our team culture, we’d love to hear from you.

To ensure a fair and streamlined process for everyone, we only accept applications through our recruitment system. We interview continuously, so feel free to reach out as soon as possible!

Please note: Nordnet conducts credit and background checks as well as a drug test on the final candidate as part of our standard process for a digital bank.

We look forward to meeting you!

jobs.title: Finance Data Analyst
jobs.description:
**Finance Data Analyst**

  

At Mediq, data plays a critical role in enabling sustainable growth, driving operational excellence, and supporting strategic decision-making across our Northern European business. We are now looking for a Finance Data Analyst who wants to take on a visible and business-critical role, helping shape the future of healthcare through data-driven financial insights, advanced analytics, and strong business partnering.

  

As part of our Nordic organization, you will work closely with colleagues across Finance, Commercial, Operations, Supply Chain, and senior leadership teams in Sweden, Norway, Finland, and Denmark. You will act as a trusted analytics partner, transforming complex financial and operational data into actionable insights that support performance, profitability, and strategic decision-making.

  

**About the role**

  

As a Finance Data Analyst, you will be part of the Nordic Finance organization. You will play a key role in developing analytical solutions, financial reporting, forecasting support, business performance management, and decision-making across the Nordic organization.

  

The role combines strong analytical capabilities, finance understanding, stakeholder management, and continuous improvement. You will work across countries and functions, providing meaningful insights through data while helping the business identify opportunities to improve performance, profitability, and operational efficiency.

  

**Key responsibilities**

  

* Analyze large financial and operational datasets to identify trends, risks, opportunities, and performance improvement initiatives.
* Develop, maintain, and improve dashboards, KPI reporting, and analytical models using Power BI and other reporting tools.
* Support financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and performance management processes through advanced analytics and scenario modeling.
* Build and automate recurring reports and data processes, improving efficiency and data quality across the organization.
* Partner with FP&A, Commercial, Supply Chain, Operations, and Business leaders to provide data-driven recommendations and insights.
* Support profitability analysis, pricing analysis, margin optimization, and cost management initiatives.
* Translate complex financial and operational data into clear business recommendations for management and key stakeholders.
* Contribute to finance transformation, reporting standardization, process improvements, and automation initiatives.
* Participate in strategic projects, business cases, and ad hoc analyses supporting decision-making across the Nordics.

  

**What you bring**

  

* University degree in Finance, Economics, Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Statistics, Accounting, or a related field.
* Minimum 3 years of experience within Finance Analytics, FP&A, Business Control, Financial Reporting, Data Analytics, or a similar analytical role.
* Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize and automate reporting and analytical processes. Reduce manual data handling and improve the reliability and scalability of recurring reports, including use of AI.
* Experience working with budgeting, forecasting, financial planning, performance management, and KPI reporting.
* Advanced Excel skills, including Power Query, Power Pivot, data modeling, and complex financial analysis.
* Hands-on experience working with Power BI and creating interactive dashboards and management reporting.
* Experience working with ERP systems and integrating data from multiple business sources.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, stakeholder management, and communication skills, with the ability to translate data into actionable business recommendations.
* Experience working with large datasets and driving insights through data visualization and advanced analysis.
* Fluent English, both written and spoken.

  

**Why join Mediq?**

  

At Mediq, you will become part of a company with a clear purpose: improving patients' lives and supporting healthcare professionals every day.

  

You will join an international organization where collaboration across countries and functions is part of everyday work. In this role, you will work closely with business leaders and finance stakeholders across the Nordics, contributing directly to strategic and operational decision-making.

  

The position offers a unique opportunity to strengthen your expertise in finance analytics, business intelligence, and business partnering while playing a key role in improving performance, profitability, and operational effectiveness across a dynamic Northern European organization.

  

Most importantly, you will work alongside dedicated colleagues who share a commitment to collaboration, continuous improvement, and making healthcare more sustainable and accessible.

  

**Location:** Kungsbacka, Sweden

  

**Apply directly on our Careers Page:** CareersatMediq.com

  

**About Mediq**

  

Mediq is a leading European healthcare company with a 125-year legacy, operating in 14 countries with over 3,000 employees. Guided by our vision to enable sustainable healthcare, we focus on improving care outcomes and affordability through innovative products, services, and solutions. Partnering with healthcare professionals across hospitals, clinics, and home care, we ensure patients receive the care they need to live independently, securely and feel more human.

  

**At Mediq we offer jobs that change lives, join us.**

jobs.title: Business Analyst, Telecom Transformation (Mission Critical Communications Hub)
jobs.description:
* Permanent
* Experienced Professionals
* Strategy & Transformation
* ID 571820-en\_US

**Om Capgemini Invent**
-----------------------

Vi på Capgemini Invent tror på att olikheter driver förändring. Som transformationskonsulter förenar vi strategiska, kreativa och vetenskapliga kompetenser och samarbetar nära våra kunder för att leverera lösningar i framkant. Bli en del av oss och driv transformation anpassad efter våra kunders utmaningar. Med vetenskap och data som grund, kreativitet och design som drivkraft – och teknik skapad med syfte som möjliggörare.

Hos oss får du möjligheten att arbeta i gränslandet mellan affär och teknik, tillsammans med några av branschens främsta experter.

**Din roll**
------------

Var med och forma framtidens samhällsviktiga kommunikationer och bidra till ett mer motståndskraftigt Sverige.

På Capgemini Invent driver vi några av Sveriges mest betydelsefulla transformationer inom telekomsektorn. Just nu arbetar vi med utvecklingen av verksamhetskritisk kommunikation (Mission Critical Communications, MCX) för offentliga verksamheter, där säkra och robusta kommunikationstjänster är avgörande för samhällets funktion.

Vi söker nu en Business Analyst som vill ta en aktiv roll i våra kunduppdrag från första dagen. Du kommer att vara en nyckelperson i att driva aktiviteter framåt, omvandla affärsbehov till tydliga krav och bidra till framgångsrik leverans i komplexa transformationsinitiativ inom telekom.

**I rollen kommer du bland annat att:**
---------------------------------------

* Driva och följa upp aktiviteter inom strategiska transformationsprogram inom telekom
* Samla in, strukturera och dokumentera verksamhetskrav samt stödja prioritering och beslutsfattande
* Säkerställa kvalitet, konsekvens och leverans av kundanpassade projektmaterial och beslutsunderlag
* Stödja planering, implementering och koordinering mellan olika verksamhets- och teknikområden
* Använda AI och nya teknologier för att effektivisera arbetssätt, analyser och leveranser

Din profil

Vi söker dig som är analytisk, strukturerad och trivs i en konsultmiljö där du får ta ansvar och skapa värde tillsammans med kund och team.

**Vi tror att du har:**
-----------------------

* 1-3 års erfarenhet som Business Analyst, managementkonsult, PMO, projektkoordinator eller liknande roll, gärna inom telekom
* Stark analytisk förmåga och erfarenhet av att omsätta affärsbehov till konkreta krav och lösningar
* Förståelse för affärsdriven transformation stöttad av IT-leveranser, systemutvecklingsprocesser och AI driven processutveckling
* Erfarenhet från telekomoperatörer såsom Telia, Tele2, Telenor eller liknande verksamheter
* Civilingenjörsexamen inom Industriell Ekonomi eller motsvarande examen inom ekonomi och management
* Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, i tal och skrift
* Svenskt medborgarskap, vilket är ett krav på grund av kundernas säkerhetskrav

**Varför Capgemini Invent?**
----------------------------

Hos oss får du möjlighet att:

* Arbeta i några av Sveriges mest samhällskritiska transformationsprojekt

* Utvecklas i en ledande konsultverksamhet med starkt fokus på innovation och teknologi

* Samarbeta med experter inom strategi, affärsutveckling, teknik och AI och bidra till lösningar som gör verklig skillnad för samhället

* Bygga en karriär i en global organisation med entreprenöriell kultur och stora utvecklingsmöjligheter

**Bra att veta**
----------------

Placering: För denna roll utgår du från vårt centralt belägna Stockholmskontor och är redo att resa till kund vid behov.

Senioritet och titel fastställs baserat på din bakgrund och erfarenhet.

Som en del av vår rekryteringsprocess genomförs identitetskontroll via ID‑handling, och bakgrundskontroller kan förekomma vid behov.

Är du redo att kombinera affärsförståelse, analys och teknik för att skapa framtidens telekomlösningar? Vi ser fram emot din ansökan.
